findings: MAJOR cross:X01: `energyState` returns `heavy` for any friction energy whatever its volume (`s < 0 → 'heavy'`). In the 600-chart sample, 315 of 1,173 and 317 of 1,248 heavy energies are thin (≤10%). That is about one heavy line in four telling a reader they hold "too much" of an energy they barely have. Example: born 1996-05-19 16h, Overfueled Wood, Water = Mind at 1% → "Water brings Mind, the energy your chart already has too much of." Each unit is shared by every chart in the state, so the claim has to hold for thin charts too. | proposed: **Rule:** a heavy or core_over line names the *valence*, not the *amount*: "more than your chart can use", "more than your chart is built for", "an energy your chart does better with less of". Never "already holds / has / carries too much", "full of", "crowded with", "in plenty", "in excess". Examples: `mind · day.heavy.a` (golden) → "{el} brings Mind, more than your chart can use today. Your thoughts circle, and you get less done than you meant to." · `order · day.heavy.b` → "{el} brings Order, a weight your chart does better with less of. A deadline tightens or a rule bites, and you work twice as hard for the same result." · `action · month.heavy` → "{el} brings Action for a whole month, more reach than your chart is built for. Work spreads thin across too many fronts, and you feel stretched by the third week." The same rule applies to Life Chapters' year lines (O1).

findings: MAJOR month:F01: The engine sets `heavy` for **every** released energy whatever its share (`engine/almanac/index.js:153`: `if (s < 0) return 'heavy'`), yet all four lines claim volume. Chart 乙亥 庚辰 己卯 癸酉 has no Fire in a stem, branch or hidden stem, and is told it has too much Fire. The 甲 chart holds Metal only as hidden 辛 and is told it is "full of" Metal. Classically (子平真诠, 论用神) the energy is released because of the Day Master's strength: an Underfueled core cannot carry the drain of Expression, Action and Order, and an Overfueled core does not need Mind. Its share is not the reason. mind.heavy also ends in praise ("you hold your ground well") for an energy the reader releases. | proposed: Rule: a `heavy` line names why the reader releases the energy (the strength of the core), never its volume, unless the engine splits `heavy` by share (≥20%). Each of these keys reaches only one condition, so the rewrites can say so: **expression.heavy** "{El} brings Expression for a whole month, more output than your chart can fund. You start many things and show them early, and your strength runs low by the last week." **action.heavy** "{El} brings Action for a whole month, more than your strength can carry. Tasks spread thin across too many fronts, and you feel stretched by the third week." **order.heavy** "{El} brings Order for a whole month, more pressure than your chart can carry. Rules and demands fill your weeks, and you get through them by keeping your head down." **mind.heavy** "{El} brings Mind for a whole month, more support than your strong chart needs. You think longer and move slower, and you hold on where you should let go." Check `ENERGY … day.heavy` for the same claim.
